decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe product line with its own webpage by 2024, substantial investment and public commitment make dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Only briefly mentioned on the website with no dedicated page or visible results suggests limited investment and little public commitment, so escalation pressures are weak and dropping is likely.
With only a website mention in both years and no dedicated presence or positive results, the supportive insole shows little public commitment, making a drop probable.
With its own page in both years, the ergonomic series reflects sustained visible commitment and central positioning, so management is likely to persist.
The move from a mere mention to a dedicated page in 2024 signals increasing investment and public commitment, making persistence likely.
Being featured on the home page in both years and backed by a visible customer success indicates high commitment and positive results, so escalation strongly favors keeping.
